recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, warm-toned close-up portrait of a man with feathered hair and a popped collar, set against a blurred, sun-drenched background with bold, two-tone sans-serif typography across the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's direct gaze creates immediate intimacy and intensity.
Warm peach and orange background tones contrast with the cool olive and blue of the clothing.
Bold white text anchors the left side, while slanted blue text provides a dynamic counterpoint on the right.
High-grain film texture unifies the photographic and typographic elements.
coreInvariants: Popped collar on a field or denim jacket

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, slightly off-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned at the vertical center-line of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold white text, moves across to the blue text, then down to the subject's face and collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with blurred shapes and warm light gradients.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm peach and muted orange (background and skin tones).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Olive green and dark shadows (clothing and hair).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan/Light Blue (secondary text and denim lining).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast in the shadows; values are compressed to mimic vintage print.

letterConstructionRules: Uppercase for primary text, Title Case for secondary
characterSpecificRedesigns: Secondary text is italicized to create a sense of motion
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold uppercase sans-serif paired with a lighter, italicized sans-serif for contrast in weight and energy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the top margin

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and American industrial feel of the primary text.
Provides the clean, slanted look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, 35mm film-style portrait of a man with 80s feathered hair, wearing an olive green jacket with a high popped collar. The background should be a warm, out-of-focus sunset orange and peach gradient with blurred mechanical or urban shapes. Lighting should be soft but directional, highlighting the texture of the skin and hair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of text at the very top. The first half should be in a bold, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif font. The second half should be in a medium-weight, cyan-blue, italicized sans-serif font. Ensure the text has a slight grain to match the photo.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible across the entire image?
Is the collar of the jacket prominently popped?
Are the two text styles distinct in color and slant?
Is the lighting warm and reminiscent of the early 1980s?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the blue accent text
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Verify the text is perfectly horizontal at the top.
Ensure the subject's expression is serious and direct.
Confirm the color palette stays within warm earth tones and cyan.
recipe.reuseFormula: Analog Portrait + Grainy Texture + Two-Tone Sans-Serif Header = 80s Heartland Rock Aesthetic
